findings.adobe_documented: Several selected Adobe tutorials demonstrate Select Subject followed by mask creation to replace a background.
findings.local_contract: For remove-background intent, server instructions require get_state, recipe_remove_background, get_preview, then stop; several atomic and scripting workarounds are forbidden.
findings.resolution: Keep these general selection/mask cards available for other suitable tasks; route explicit background removal to the server contract and do not silently adopt the tutorial chain.

findings.adobe_documented: Learn selection basics demonstrates Image > Adjustments on the selected pixels.
findings.local_preference: User asks for editable layers, masks, and Smart Objects when supported.
findings.resolution: Teach the selection concept, but use an available nondestructive adjustment-layer route when its MCP implementation is verified; document any unsupported route.

findings.adobe_documented: Select and Mask tutorials include interactive Refine Edge Brush, preview modes, and preference choices.
findings.local_capability: This research batch has not mapped or executed those controls through MCP.
findings.resolution: Keep mapping_pending until tools and implementation are inspected. A similarly named refinement tool does not prove all interactive controls are exposed.

findings.issue: The 2026 paragraph on endpoint movement describes moving the lower-left point right as lightening shadows and the upper-right point left as darkening highlights. This conflicts with the same article's input/output mapping and its description of black/white input sliders.
findings.handling: Do not encode those endpoint-direction sentences into a recipe. The card uses the internally consistent vertical point movement rule only. Verify any endpoint mapping on a grayscale copy before declaring it tested.

findings.issue: These Learn tutorials explicitly demonstrate Photoshop on the web. Their UI controls, defaults, saving behavior, and layer sampling do not prove parity with the installed desktop ExtendScript MCP.
findings.handling: Keep the documented editing principles, confirm desktop behavior through Help and current MCP schemas, and leave actual MCP support and execution status separate.

findings.issue: The page has a July 2026 publication date while its transcript calls Perspective Warp a new Photoshop CC feature.
findings.handling: Treat the transcript as technique evidence only; verify current version, hardware, and MCP availability independently. Do not infer a 2026-only requirement or confuse Free Transform perspective with Perspective Warp.

findings.resolution: Retain the proportional-transform objective; verify current behavior/parameters instead of transcribing the old Shift instruction.

findings.issue: PPI simplified recommendations versus actual output requirements
findings.resolution: The detailed Learn transcript limits300ppi to a typical inkjet example and distinguishes screen pixels from PPI. Print-specific requirements remain contextual; do not hardcode300ppi for wallpaper.

findings.issue: Generative cost/output/model information changes across dated Adobe pages
findings.resolution: Do not freeze older FAQ claims of one credit or1024px across all models. Check current model, plan, output size, credit terms and installed-version support. Account access and MCP execution remain untested.
